scope: Independent source/configuration review of Group E. This finalization writes only the two independent-review files; the preceding user-authorized remediation changed only Group E pack/builder/audit files. No shared data, main browser use, integration, commits or publication.

summary.sourceOutcome: Independent final-pack signoff: all 19 retained candidates and 119 source-reviewed rows pass with zero open remediation advisories. E-001, E-004 and E-005 are resolved against the exact final pack hash. Five existing model holds and Quattro exclusions remain mandatory. This is not approval to publish held models or a browser/publication signoff.

methods: Fresh direct public HTTP re-fetched all retained numeric/SKU evidence endpoints: Ande live HTML variant metadata plus product JSON; every Hi-Seas exact SKU title; Reaction and CAST exact product JSON; each Vicious retained-strength product JSON; Rhino public embedded ProductDetailsLoader; KastKing exact product JSON.
Independently visually read eight numeric/package chart images: three Ande, four Vicious and one KastKing. Read all 19 selected product photos plus eight Hi-Seas conflict photos.
Compared every retained numeric row and exact package scope; examined unusual thin values and independently rounded unit pairs rather than imposing generic diameter assumptions.

Reviewed construction, suitability, strength guidance, spooling guidance, FAQs and source caveats for all 19 gold configs; looked for model/formulation/role conflation and unsupported performance recommendations.

In-memory existing-engine check of 33 saved mainline examples using source-row overrides and real reel IDs found one over-capacity saved plan; current capacity-only rendering path was read to qualify actual impact.

Final-pack verification: 2,221 scoped consistency checks, 58 focused hash/builder/caption/capacity checks, and four builder syntax checks passed. All 33 saved examples fit. Full row objects and all fields outside the authorized copy/example edits have identical before/after hashes.
sourceAccessNote: Web extraction incorrectly returned unrelated Beadalon content for an AFW URL. Direct public HTTP returned200 and the exact fishing SKU title; the unrelated web extraction was not used as product evidence.

requiredIntegrationGates: Keep Hi-Seas CFC-F200 held and Quattro limited to 8/10/25 lb; do not stage an older pack revision.
Route Quattro and Ande fluorocarbon leader to the leader renderer. Do not expose these leaders as Wizard mainlines or full-spool recommendations.

limitations: No physical diameter or fill measurements; source accuracy is distinct from manufacturer claim truth.
Family photos often have blank test fields or show a different strength; all were inspected for actual family/color identity, not claimed to dynamically match every selection.

Four pre-existing non-Hi-Seas holds were accounted for but not independently researched to a new resolution; this assignment prioritized the 19 source-verified candidates plus the high-risk Hi-Seas hold.
Group E changed Quattro from seven to three rows during review. Conclusions apply only to the exact recorded pack hash.
Subsequent held-model resolution research is separate and cannot alter this signoff or admit new rows without its own reviewed pack.
